sn4.19:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhū nibbāṇapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya saṃdasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
sn4.19:1.3: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhi katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.
sn4.19:2.2: ayaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo bhikkhū nibbāṇapaṭisaṃyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya -pe- sampahaṃseti. te ca bhikkhu -pe- dhammaṃ suṇanti.
sn4.19:2.3: yannūnāhaṃ yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkameyyaṃ vicakkhukammāyāti.
sn4.19:2.4: atha kho māro pāpimā kassakavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā mahantaṃ naṅgalaṃ khandhe karitvā dīghaṃ pācanayaṭṭhiṃ gahetvā haṭahaṭakeso sāṇasāṭinivattho kaddamamakkhitehi pādehi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn4.19:2.7: mameva samaṇa cakkhu, mama rūpā, mama cakkhusamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ.
sn4.19:2.9: mameva samaṇa sotaṃ, mama saddā, mama sotasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ.
sn4.19:2.10: mameva samaṇa ghānaṃ, mama gandhā, mama ghāṇasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ.
sn4.19:2.11: mameva samaṇa jivhā, mama rasā, mama jivhāsamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ.
sn4.19:2.12: mameva samaṇa kāyo, mama phoṭṭhabbā, mama kāyasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ.
sn4.19:2.13: mameva samaṇa mano, mama dhammā, mama manosamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ.
sn4.19:3.1: taveva pāpima cakkhu, tava rūpā, tava cakkhusamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ.
sn4.19:3.2: yattha ca kho pāpima natthi cakkhu, natthi rūpā, natthi cakkhusamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ. agati tava tattha pāpima.
sn4.19:3.3: taveva pāpima sotaṃ, tava saddā, tava sotasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ.
sn4.19:3.4: yattha ca kho pāpima natthi sotaṃ, natthi saddā, natthi sotasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ. agati tava tattha pāpima.
sn4.19:3.5: taveva pāpima ghānaṃ, tava gandhā, tava ghāṇasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ.
sn4.19:3.7: taveva pāpima jivhā, tava rasā, tava jivhāsamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ -pe- agati tava tattha pāpima.
sn4.19:3.8: taveva pāpima kāyo, tava phoṭṭhabbā tava kāyasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ -pe- agati tava tattha pāpima.
sn4.19:3.9: taveva pāpima mano, tava dhammā, tava manosamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ.
sn4.19:3.10: yattha ca kho pāpima natthi mano, natthi dhammā, natthi manosamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṃ. agati tava tattha pāpimāti.
